_about: Expected-red set for the canonical-main smoke gate (D-0b14e7d3).

This file is ONE of TWO surfaces that suppress a gate alert; check both before concluding
a red is untracked. (1) This file: the in-repo quarantine list (D-6880b42e), reviewed in
PRs and carried with the checkout. (2) The confirmed-red ledger at
<state_dir>/confirmed-red-ledger.json, added by main-gate 55c1208b8 after D-afa5b09b3111
re-alerted on every tick: a runner-side, MACHINE-LOCAL record that also suppresses. Its
invariant is that it may only ever suppress noise, never create truth; alerting is a
one-way ratchet, so a red alerts once and a ledgered test never alerts again while it
stays there. It has its own exit rule (N consecutive passes drops the entry), so it holds
temporary suppressions this file should not. It is NOT in this repo: a fresh checkout on
another machine has this file and no ledger, and will alert on everything the ledger is
holding. The alert footer prints the ledger depth as "Main is carrying N unfixed confirmed
red(s)" - a non-zero N means suppressed reds exist that are NOT listed below.
The gate runs the full smoke project on darwin at workers:1 / retries:0 and alerts only on
reds NOT listed here, after confirming them by re-running the affected spec files.
Entries are keyed on file + full title. NOT file:line — line is informational only.
'Full title' means Playwright's bare spec.title — NO describe prefix. On PW 1.60 specs carry
no titlePath; describe names live on the enclosing suites and are NOT part of the key. A
'describe › test' entry matches nothing and silently un-quarantines its test (found 2026-08-30:
4 such entries were dead and their flakes surfaced as new reds).
messaging.spec.ts generates two tests from one `for` loop at the SAME line (4495), so a
line-keyed list would silently quarantine the wrong variant.
class=deterministic      reproduced in every run it appeared in; a real red with an owner.
class=quarantined-flake  observed passing AND failing across runs; suppressed, not accepted.
When a test is fixed, delete its entry in the same commit as the fix.
Measured on darwin, retries:0 — this set is platform- and retry-specific and is NOT a claim
about upstream's ubuntu CI, which runs with retries:2.

measured.note: 19 of the 28 were the D-4f05940c cluster, fixed in 0f6450592 and not listed here.
